newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices up on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices up on overseas demand.

text.p: Most Bangladeshi teas moved up slightly on demand from blenders and overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Buyers for Pakistan and Poland operated actively while blenders and local traders also lent good support to the market, they said.
More than 1.2 million kg of tea was sold at the auction.
The average price was 43.81 taka, up 0.56 from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on October 1 with an offer of 1.41 million kg.
